title: Vision Pipeline Capstone
motto: A production vision system is a chain of models and rules stitched with data contracts. The pieces are already in this phase; the capstone wires them together end-to-end.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: A production vision system is a chain of models and rules stitched with data contracts. The pieces are already in this phase; the capstone wires them together end-to-end.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Individual vision models are useful; vision products are chains of them. A retail shelf audit is a detector plus a product classifier plus a price-OCR pipeline. Autonomous driving is a 2D detector plus a 3D detector plus a segmenter plus a tracker plus a planner. A medical pre-screen is a segmenter plus a region classifier plus a clinician UI.

Wiring those chains is the part that separates a ML prototype from a product. Every interface between models is a new place for bugs. Every coordinate transform, every normalisation, every mask resize is a silent-failure candidate. A pipeline is as strong as its weakest interface.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Ingest → preprocess → model → postprocess → API. Production CV is a pipeline.
